messages.content: 非常感謝！在我開始這段旅程之前，確保我不會因為油箱空了而被困是很有道理的。只需將油箱加滿即可。

But user says "只需將油箱加滿即可" meaning "just fill the tank". So we need to fill to capacity. The tank holds up to 50 gallons. We don\'t know current level. We could assume empty? But better to ask. But user says just fill. We can interpret as fill to full capacity. So we call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 50? But if tank already has some fuel, adding 50 would exceed capacity. We might need to get current fuel level. There\'s no function to get current fuel level. So we can\'t know. We could ask user how much to add. But user says just fill. We can ask for clarification. But maybe we can assume they want to fill to full capacity, so we can call fillFuelTank with 50 gallons. Let\'s do that.')
